remarks: Wake up to sparkling marina views and coastal breezes at Palmer Landing, a waterfront enclave on the coveted shoreline of Shippan Point and one of Stamford's most sought-after communities. This beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 3-bath end-unit townhouse has been newly renovated and completely repainted, featuring custom built-in closets on the main level and a remodeled main floor bathroom. Heat and hot water are included in the common charges, adding everyday comfort and convenience. The sun-filled main level offers an open, airy layout perfect for both relaxed living and entertaining, opening to one of two private waterfront decks overlooking the marina - a tranquil, vacation-like retreat where every morning coffee and evening cocktail feels like you're on the coast at a private resort. A wood-burning fireplace, rich hardwood floors, and a sleek kitchen with stainless steel appliances create a warm yet sophisticated atmosphere. Upstairs, the primary suite features a walk-in closet, spa-inspired bath with an oversized walk-in shower, and its own private 2nd waterfront deck-an ideal place to unwind and enjoy the tranquil water views. Located just moments from sandy beaches, dining, shopping, and downtown Stamford, this exceptional residence offers a rare opportunity to enjoy luxury waterfront living in one of Stamford's most desirable coastal communities.
